recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If current MolecularDefinition strand terminology needs tighter guidance, handle that through a separate current-resource issue rather than by backporting retired Sequence.referenceSeq.strand wording.
issue_request: FHIR-11238 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request against DSTU2 FHIR-core Sequence. It asked that Sequence.referenceSeq.strand replace vague 'Strand of DNA' wording with acceptable values: 1 for plus strand (5' to 3')/Watson/Sense/positive and -1 for minus strand (3' to 5')/Crick/Antisense/negative.
initial_application: Historical commit 6072b705b6 changed source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml to include the requested directionality and numeric value definitions. Commit a26b8894d0 added Sequence notes mapping +1/-1 to Watson/Crick, Sense/Antisense, and positive/negative, so the issue was applied to the artifact it targeted.
additional_context: FHIR-14273 later split the same semantics into watson/crick strand plus sense/antisense orientation, applied by ed2a92ec79. FHIR-19453 renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence in 78abae0217, and current fhir.ini lists Sequence under removed resources while MolecularSequence is commented out/absent from active resources. MolecularDefinition has a separate CodeableConcept strand element and is not the retired integer Sequence.referenceSeq.strand field.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source was edited because reapplying the old +1/-1 guidance would target an out-of-build artifact and would conflict with later Clinical Genomics decisions that superseded the original single-field integer model.
